title: minify selectors
author: qsliu2017
summary: Removes duplicate selectors from a style rule's selector list (`.foo, .bar, .foo` -> `.foo, .bar`) in StyleRule::minify. Semantically safe (same specificity, first occurrence kept). But it serializes every selector into a String and allocates a HashSet for every style rule on the hot path, for a case the maintainer questioned in real code; and it runs before rule merging, so duplicates created by merging stay.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI: `a,a{color:red}` -> `a,a{color:red}`; `.a,.b{color:red}.a{color:red}` -> `.a,.b,.a{color:red}` (that duplicate comes from merging and this PR wouldn't remove it). devongovett on #240 (2022-07-31): "Seems reasonable. When does this happen in real-world code though?" No PR comments. The head is the author's fork master branch. Should skip lists of length 1 and compare selectors structurally rather than via to_css_string; a size-check would show whether it pays off.
